title: Nutritious Jammy Turkish Skirt Steak Kebabs
description: Kid-friendly Turkish skewers featuring jammy, fragrant seasoning and tender skirt steak, perfect for dinner.
instructions: Cut the trimmed skirt steak into 1-inch cubes.
In a bowl, whisk together olive oil, tomato paste, honey jam, paprika, cumin, oregano, minced garlic, salt, and pepper until smooth.
Add the steak cubes to the bowl and toss to coat evenly; let marinate for 10 minutes.
Thread the steak cubes, onion slices, and alternating pieces onto the skewers.
Preheat a grill or grill pan over medium-high heat.
Place the skewered kebabs on the grill and cook, turning occasionally, until the steak is browned and cooked to desired doneness, about 5-7 minutes per side.
While grilling, brush the kebabs with a little extra tomato paste mixture to keep them jammy.
Remove the kebabs from the grill and let them rest for 3 minutes.
Serve the kebabs hot, spooning any remaining sauce from the grill pan over the top.
Garnish with fresh parsley if desired.
